<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>GDP and Monetary Policy:</strong> Robust Q1 FY27 GDP growth has prompted economists and brokerages to raise growth forecasts while increasing the probability of an RBI rate hike as early as December to manage inflation risks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxNYy1uT09sbTYwSGc3cG4ydkxGMWRQdktxengzUUEtMXFWUkY1MUszdVJCOWxGNjFKY0VEZmM2NW8xWGdVWkdfc2tIak45dXZfNUZzOTBJOUUzNnBRcEIyY2hyMWFWaUgyMzJGZU1pY0NsRlYyWE1VMXowQ0txWjNudlJ0X24zWEgzbl9zeWJkakN2Y3J0U05qRjU0ZGhSbmpZSFJxOUgyaGZybmxQdWc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I30</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Currency Dynamics:</strong> The Indian rupee reached a two-month high, supported by consistent FPI inflows and strategic RBI intervention, despite broader market pressure.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Performance:</strong> Domestic indices closed marginally lower as a surge in Brent crude oil prices above $91, driven by geopolitical tensions, offset the positive sentiment from strong economic data.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxOS09BTG5OdkhIcFVYS3ZMUzBFR3NkN1ZMVV9RT3Q3Y0RUajNteDZBdTVtVF9HZTJjSzNhSVRGT1IwcWZfZ0Vldk9fWE1icUgxd2ZtQTFSX0VIdW0yRzNBb1hMblFveEtGbHlUOGtwREtveXlod2tQcjZXSWVPcGMwdk93TlI5OFFSY3NBSHFfd1JMOHZGb2JudzY5aFVLSDNwNVJIWVRqUlNwNlF1WnJ1OW9KWWhOTllwRkhESmVxaWljeFB1SUpuMFBPMA?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I27</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxNVTJBcWRiYmJsbzlJUE9CZklueUg0WkF3U2t3a1VyaUtYRUYxWk5sOU85ZlZJSEM4UGtqT1BtVTZhOGVjc1hHTDhFNkNIenduVnpHWkVDSjhGX1FQaGowMXZIVXJVREs1OGF3eHVPVmRacnVZX2Z1VlF1NG9vaVN1LXFaX1JZQnhkYzByMzVSdDBvcW1WV0FVVHdhZ1RBaTBUY3V0VWdfTGduNTJwUF9WTG5OdmJ5WTVyMU1Bb2pOOFNOcFhsdF80?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I34</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Geopolitical and Energy Risks:</strong> Escalating U.S.-Iran tensions have pushed Brent crude prices past $91 per barrel, creating a cautious environment for global equities and impacting import-dependent economies like India.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxNVTJBcWRiYmJsbzlJUE9CZklueUg0WkF3U2t3a1VyaUtYRUYxWk5sOU85ZlZJSEM4UGtqT1BtVTZhOGVjc1hHTDhFNkNIenduVnpHWkVDSjhGX1FQaGowMXZIVXJVREs1OGF3eHVPVmRacnVZX2Z1VlF1NG9vaVN1LXFaX1JZQnhkYzByMzVSdDBvcW1WV0FVVHdhZ1RBaTBUY3V0VWdfTGduNTJwUF9WTG5OdmJ5WTVyMU1Bb2pOOFNOcFhsdF80?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Global Yields:</strong> European markets remain muted and Japanese bond yields have touched 3% for the first time in three decades, reflecting heightened global concerns over inflation and fiscal stability.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W10</a></span></li>
</ul>
